quantification_strategy: TMT reporter ion in MS3 spectra

acquisition: Mass spectrometer was set to collect one MS1 scan (Orbitrap; 120K resolution; AGC target 2x105; max IT 50 ms) followed by data-dependent, “Top Speed” (3 seconds) MS2 scans
For multinotch-MS3, the top 10 precursors from each MS2 were fragmented by HCD followed by Orbitrap analysis
labeling: A TMT10plex™ isobaric labeling kit (0090110, Thermo Fisher Scientific) was used to label each sample
TMT labeling of lysine and N-termini of peptides (229.16293 Da) were considered static modifications
quantification: Quantitation was performed using TMT reporter ion in MS3 spectra
enrichment: We used an intact cell proximity-based labeling approach using BioID2 coupled to tandem mass tag (TMT)-based quantitative proteomics
The remaining equalized lysates were incubated with 500 μL Pierce™ streptavidin magnetic beads slurry per sample, in an end-over-end overnight 4°C for 18 hr.

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses BioID2 for proximity labeling of proteins, followed by streptavidin affinity purification and TMT-based quantification using a multinotch-MS3 acquisition mode on an Orbitrap Fusion.

organism: Tandem MS spectra were searched against SwissProt human protein database
cell_lines: Low passage HT1080 cells (passage number up to 15) were used for proximity labeling experiments.
A293 cells were plated in a 6-well plate
scope: we adopted a proximity labeling approach using BioID2, a promiscuous biotin ligase enzyme, coupled to affinity purification and MS.
The remaining equalized lysates were incubated with 500 μL Pierce™ streptavidin magnetic beads slurry per sample, in an end-over-end overnight 4°C for 18 hr.
Following streptavidin pull-down, beads were washed twice with ice-cold modRIPA, and once with ice-cold 1× PBS.
On-bead digestion followed by LC-MS/MS analysis was performed

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis specifically utilized BioID2-mediated proximity labeling followed by streptavidin affinity purification to isolate biotinylated proteins from HT1080 cell lysates. While A293 cells were used for validation via Western Blot, the primary MS dataset (PXD027905) is derived from HT1080 cells.
